pages.title: Your SteakOS Journey
pages.text:
The path is clear and rewarding:
1. Learn the big ideas (this tour)
2. Set up your system with a simple wizard
3. Try your first real transaction
4. Use it every day with smart help
5. Grow as your business grows
examples: Day 1: Send your first invoice and feel accomplished
Week 2: The system starts giving you useful suggestions automatically
Month 3: Add new features when your business needs them

pages.title: What to Expect After the Tour
pages.text: After this tour you'll run the configuration wizard. It will ask simple questions and set up your system based on your answers. Then you'll be ready to post your first real transaction.
examples: A small shop owner posted their first sale the same day
A consultant had their first client invoice ready in under 10 minutes
